entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
The 1st respondent in the O.P is the appellant in M.A.C.A.No.538 of 2016.
2.

The petitioner filed the O.P under Section 166 of the Motor Vehicles Act, claiming compensation for the injuries sustained in a Motor vehicle accident that occurred on 26.07.2009 at about 3.00 p.m, involving an Innova car bearing Reg.No.KL-45-008.

As per the impugned award, the tribunal directed the 3rd respondent to pay a compensation of Rs.1,37,500/- to the petitioner and authorised the 3rd respondent to recover the same from the 1st respondent, who is the owner of the vehicle, one Jose.
According to the 1st respondent, even before the date of the accident, he had transferred the ownership of the vehicle to one K.A Muhammed Sherreef S/o Jamal Moideen.

3. The 1st respondent has also produced a copy of the registration particulars of the vehicle KL-45-008, showing that the ownership of the said vehicle was transferred in favour of one K.A Muhammed Sherreef 1660 of 2014 2025:KER:11310 S/o Jamal Moideen with effect from 17.07.2009.

Since the accident involved in this case occurred on 26.07.2009, on the date of the accident the registered owner of the above vehicle was one K.A Muhammed Sherreef S/o Jamal Moideen and not the 1st respondent herein.

In the above circumstances, the impugned order passed by the tribunal against the previous order is liable to be set aside and the matter is to be remanded back to the tribunal for fresh consideration.
4.
In the result, M.A.C.A.No.538 of 2016 is allowed.
The impugned award of the tribunal is set aside.
The case is remanded back to the tribunal for disposal afresh, after giving the opportunity to the claimant to implead the actual registered owner.
Consequently, M.A.C.A.No.1660/2014 is closed with liberty to the appellant therein to approach the court after the tribunal disposes of the claim petition afresh.
No costs.

Sd/-
C. PRATHEEP KUMAR, JUDGE vnk/-
